purpose: Turn existing verified local Song material, lineage and audition foundations into a consumer-reachable read-only engineering evidence snapshot for an exact Song Version WAV. Measurements must remain bound to the exact Artist/Song/Version/Asset fingerprint and must never masquerade as taste, mastering approval or autonomous mutation authority.

lineage.outcome: N0TE provides useful producer/engineer evidence on the exact Song material the artist is hearing, without leaving Artist/Song context or turning measurement into taste law.
lineage.capability: Evidence-bound Song engineering snapshot over verified local audio

why_now: The user explicitly reselected N0TE after the prior build harness reached STABLE. AUDIO-01 is dependency-ready, advances the producer/engineer value spine more directly than another controller/UX pass or full cross-format plugin hosting, and reuses existing verified Song bytes, lineage and local audition rather than creating a parallel analyzer product.

implementation_contract.consumer_composition: Install idempotently into the canonical Song page through the repository's established shell-extension composition; do not create a parallel audio dashboard or route.
implementation_contract.truthfulness: Do not label RMS as LUFS, do not infer mastering quality from thresholds, and do not turn signal measurements into artistic prescriptions.

completion_proof: a verified managed PCM WAV can be analyzed deterministically without loading the entire file into memory
engineering results are bound to exact Song, Version, Asset, SHA-256, byte size and analyzer version
